$comment: Every Cloudflare Worker secret Switchboard provisions: which Worker(s) hold it and where the canonical value lives. Values: ~/.secrets/switchboard/<NAME> (mode 600) mirrored 1:1 by the 1Password Employee item 'Switchboard: <NAME>' (tags switchboard, switchboard/<worker>). `npm run secrets` in each deploy/cloudflare*/ puts from those files via deploy/bin/put-secrets.mjs — a missing required file fails loudly. Rotation = new value in 1P + the file + `npm run secrets` on EVERY listed Worker (shared bearers must match on both ends). Public config (URLs, IDs of no consequence) is a wrangler.jsonc var, not a secret. src/core/secretsManifest.test.ts keeps this file honest against each worker.ts Env interface.

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.note: Slack app bot token (xoxb-). Third-party; rotate in the Slack app config.

secrets.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
secrets.note: Slack app-level token (xapp-) for Socket Mode. Third-party.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.note: Anthropic Console key the bot runs on. Third-party.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.note: Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin…) for the LLM-spend layer of GET /costs. Never set on prod so far — /costs shows the Cloudflare side only.

secrets.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
secrets.note: Brave Search API key for the research agent's web search. Third-party.

secrets.name: CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN
secrets.note: Cloudflare API token, coreplane-infra, Account Analytics:Read — prices GET /costs from billing data.

secrets.name: SWITCHBOARD_INGRESS_TOKENS
secrets.note: JSON bearer→identity map for POST /ingress and POST /mcp. Self-minted (openssl rand -hex 32 per entry).

secrets.name: SANDBOX_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: bot → thread-sandbox Worker. Self-minted.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_OPERATOR_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: bot runtime → resident Worker attach/exec/read/write/status. Self-minted. Rotating it breaks in-flight resident runs — check /runs is empty first.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: `repo onboard/offboard/reconfigure/rebuild` → resident admin routes; also the resident deploy preflight. Self-minted.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_READ_TOKEN
secrets.note: Read-only /residents + debug routes; what `npm run deploy` in deploy/cloudflare-resident needs for its preflight. Self-minted.

secrets.name: MEMORY_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer for the state Worker (memory, friction ledger, run history, schedule firings). ONE value on all three Workers — 2026-08-30 the resident got a different mint and every watchdog firing record 401'd. Self-minted.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
secrets.note: GitHub App `coreplane-switchboard` id (4630317). Not sensitive, but lives alongside the key so both Workers mint installation tokens the same way.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID
secrets.note: Installation of that App on the coreplanelabs org (154528180). Not sensitive.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.note: The App's PEM. Second credential domain: the resident holds its own copy; rotate both together (GitHub → generate new key → put on both → revoke old).
